thread:
lena: Heads-up — planning client-bridge v12 rollout tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 PST. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, and rollback owner.

sam: I can own deploy. Will be on-call that window.

anya: I can run smoke tests and watch metrics (latency, error-rate, 99p).

marco: I'll prepare rollback artifacts and the quick revert playbook.

lena: Awesome. @sam please kick off deploy 09:00. @anya run the smoke checklist below and confirm pass within 10m. @marco have rollback ready and flagged in the console.

sam: noted. What's the expected client impact? Any breaking changes to public SDK?

lena: Breaking changes: none for core HTTP API. There's a minor param rename in the JS SDK (request.timeout -> request.readTimeout). We published migration guide and compatibility shim in the devex repo.

anya: For smoke, I'll run these checks:

```bash
# sanity generation across models
curl -X POST $REDWOOD_API/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"smoke"}'
# embeddings sanity
curl -X POST $REDWOOD_API/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-lite","input":["smoke test"]}'
# client SDK minimal integration tests
npm run smoke:client --workspace=clients/js
```

lena: devex — can you send the short client comms (changelog + migration quickfix) to #announcements and docs today? Prefer a 2-sentence slack post + link to migration code sample. :loudspeaker:

devex: Yup, I'll draft and post by EOD PST. I'll include sample shim snippet and call out the param rename.

marco: Rollback plan: tag v12-enable=false in feature flags, then roll back traffic via the routing policy (console -> models -> traffic). If anything else, redeploy previous model sha. I've added the exact commands in the runbook.

sam: If smoke passes, I'll promote canary -> full by 09:20. If error-rate > 1% or latency p99 regresses > 50ms, I'll cut and call rollback.

lena: Good thresholds. Also watch cost tokens for the canary — devex, add a dashboard widget for the canary key.

devex: Done — dashboard link: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/canary-v12 (will post in channel).

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled by sam for 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Canary at 10% for 10 minutes, ramp to 100% if smoke green.

anya: Quick question — any external clients we should proactively notify (partners/customer list)?

lena: RSVP list: partners@redwood, enterprise-customers who use pinned model versions. I'll ping sales to notify top 5 customers.

marco: I've also added a small rollback sanity check: after flag flip, run k/v cache flush check: `redis-cli --cluster call flushdb` (only on canary cluster).

sam: All set from my side. Will post status updates in this thread during the window.

lena: Thanks everyone — final checklist: deploy owner=sam, smoke=anya, rollback=marco, comms=devex. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
